THE 1989 OBSERVATION AND NOT THE 1990 ONE: a reserve is a stock, and the stock on the morning of the 1 January 1990 start date is the end-1989 figure - the same reasoning pop_growth_1990 above gives for ending its window on 31 December 1989. note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 16 were held and are listed below with their citations; 32 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_packet_internetworking, core_single_mode_fiber, core_carbon_composites, core_combined_cycle_turbine, comp_risc_superscalar, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, comm_geostationary_comsat, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_lean_production, matl_single_crystal_superalloy, matl_rare_earth_magnet, matl_stereolithography, aero_precision_munitions, aero_pulse_doppler_radar, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_quiet_submarine, aero_recon_satellite, bio_oral_rehydration, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_monoclonal_antibody, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, agri_drip_irrigation, agri_composite_membrane, agri_conservation_tillage, agri_integrated_pest_management, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

COLLISION RESOLVED. Two authoring boards ruled the same cell for this nation and disagreed. The tie-break is uniform across the whole roster and is not a preference between authors: the cell belongs to the board that owns the technology's domain in the registry, which for every non-core id is also its id prefix, and which both cross-domain authors published as their own deferral. core_packet_internetworking -> NOT HELD (semiconductors-computing said held, telecom-space said not held; resolved to the board that owns the Communications domain, telecom-space).

SECOND AUTHORING PASS, 2026-08-31, USE-SIDE ONLY. The first pass was correctly instructed to rule NOT HELD when unsure, and produced a defensible but ragged board: the convergence channel was reading that transcription's INCOMPLETENESS as this nation's IGNORANCE, and paying it to catch up to things it already had. A second pass therefore re-ruled the 31 USE-SIDE nodes against an explicit standard published before any nation was looked at, each limb written separately into every source string. LIMB A: a citable fact putting the technology in general commercial or public service across the OECD on or before 31 December 1989, asserted once per technology and identical for every nation. LIMB B: the nation is in the Advanced Set - 1990 OECD member AND World Bank high-income in the 1990 groupings AND one of the 29 authored majors: australia canada france germany italy japan netherlands spain sweden switzerland uk usa. LIMB C: a performed and RECORDED search for a named fact placing the nation outside that deployment; a silent limb C is a failed limb C. Where limb A failed for a technology the board said so and fell back to the first pass's named-artefact bar rather than granting on the class claim - which is why several second-pass refusals contradict the brief's own opening cut. THE SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE BAR IS UNCHANGED: producing a jet engine is still producing a jet engine, and not one of the 17 sovereignty-side ids was added, removed or re-reasoned by this pass. THE PASS IS ADDITIONS-ONLY - no first-pass grant was removed or weakened - and it was authored blind of model output, with the simulation never run and no CAGR, gap or instrument reading consulted. ADDED BY THE SECOND PASS FOR THIS NATION, 7 cells: agri_protected_cultivation (health and agriculture board), bio_cross_sectional_imaging (health and agriculture board), bio_recombinant_pharma (health and agriculture board), comp_relational_database (computing and telecommunications board), core_pcr (health and agriculture board), ener_crystalline_silicon_module (energy and transport board), tran_electronic_freight_documents (energy and transport board). The refused list above has been reduced by exactly those ids and by nothing else; every other first-pass refusal stands untouched, and each new grant carries its own citation below.

CLASS E2, and the strongest kind - CLINICAL DIAGNOSTIC use, not a bench demonstration: Gasparini P, Novelli G, Savoia A, Dallapiccola B, 'First-trimester prenatal diagnosis of cystic fibrosis using the polymerase chain reaction: report of eight cases', Prenatal Diagnosis 1989;9(5):349-55 (PMID 2726700), Istituto di Scienze Biologiche, University of Verona. Eight pregnancies diagnosed by PCR in an Italian university institute in 1989. Corroborated by 'Cloning immunoglobulin variable domains for expression by the polymerase chain reaction', Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 1989 (PMID 2726754), Division of Experimental Oncology E, Istituto Nazionale per lo Studio e la Cura dei Tumori, Milan; and 'HIV viral sequences in seronegative people at risk detected by in situ hybridisation and polymerase chain reaction', BMJ 1989 (PMID 2496818), Institute of Infectious Diseases, University of Rome. Three named Italian institutions in three cities. LIMB C SEARCHED: nothing found.

SECOND PASS 2026-08-31, use-side OECD-deployment standard. LIMB A (class claim, E4 + E3, asserted once for this technology and identical for every nation, before any nation was looked at): relational database management with SQL over it was in general commercial service across the OECD before 31 December 1989. E4 - SQL was standardised as ANSI X3.135-1986 'Database Language SQL' and published internationally as ISO 9075:1987; a query language is not taken through a national and then an international standards body before there is a commercial market of implementations for it to make interoperable. E3 - the class installed base is the source the first pass itself relied on for the other eleven Advanced Set grants: Oracle corporate histories (Encyclopedia.com 'Oracle Systems Corporation'; FundingUniverse 'History of Oracle Corporation') record 17 international marketing subsidiaries as at 1986. LIMB B (membership): Italy is a founding member of the OECD, Convention signed 14 December 1960 and in force 30 September 1961, and is classified high-income in the World Bank 1990 income groupings on 1988 GNP per capita; Italy is therefore in the Advanced Set. LIMB C (defeater search, PERFORMED AND RECORDED): no named, citable fact was found placing Italy outside OECD relational-database deployment. The search returned a counter-fact on the very series the first pass used to corroborate all eleven existing grants - World Bank IT.CMP.PCMP.P2 for 1990 gives Italy 3.68 PCs per 100, 1.5x the 1990 World value of 2.45, and ABOVE Spain's 2.81; Spain was granted this cell by the first pass on that same corroboration. Italy also already holds comp_microprocessor on this board on that identical statistic. NOT ASSERTED, BECAUSE IT COULD NOT BE SOURCED: no founding date for an Oracle subsidiary in Italy is claimed here, because the cited histories give a subsidiary count and not the country list, and inventing the date would be fabricating a citation. This grant rests on the class claim plus the recorded defeater search rather than on a named local installation, which is precisely what the second-pass standard authorises for a use-side, diffuse-practice technology in the Advanced Set, and nothing weaker than that is being claimed.

The Rospo Mare field, offshore Italy in the Adriatic, operated by Elf Aquitaine: horizontal wells were drilled there from 1982 and are the registry's own cited exemplar for this node ('Elf's Rospo Mare wells in the early 1980s proved it offshore'). Rospo Mare is a shallow heavy-oil karst reservoir that is only commercial horizontally, and it was in horizontal production through the 1980s and into the 1990s. The predicate for this node is explicitly 'in this nation's fields, BY WHATEVER OPERATOR', so a French operator drilling in Italian waters grants the technology to Italy and not to France. That is the split working as designed, and it is the tree's own citation.

LIMB A FAILS and is not used - photovoltaics was trivial as generation in 1990 by the registry's own account. Granted on the named-artefact bar, on the standard the board already applied to Germany, Switzerland, Australia, Japan and the USA. LIMB B: Italy is in the Advanced Set. EVIDENCE E2, a named plant in the nation, dated: DELPHOS - Demonstrative Electrical Photovoltaic System - the ENEA plant at Manfredonia in Apulia, INAUGURATED ON 13 DECEMBER 1986 and at that time THE LARGEST PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEM EVER BUILT IN EUROPE: 4,320 crystalline-silicon modules over about 4,200 square metres for 300 kW of nominal installed power, connected to the distribution network, the energy produced feeding in part the utilities of the ENEA experimental area. Source: ENEA press release, 'I 20 anni di fotovoltaico dell'Impianto DELPHOS dell'ENEA a Manfredonia'. The plant was designed for 1.2 MWp overall, its first 300 kWp section is the one at issue, and its performance after a first year of operation was analysed in the ENEA and IEEE literature, which reported the array delivering about 85% of nominal peak power after temperature, mismatch and resistive losses (Barra, Castello, Li Causi, Messana, Sarno, 'Delphos photovoltaic plant (Italian ENEA program)'; and the IEEE PVSC paper 'Analysis of Delphos 300 kW connected PV plant after the first year of operation'). This is also, on the brief's own first cut, the named Italian exemplar it expected to be found. LIMB C SEARCHED: no named, citable fact was found placing Italy outside photovoltaic operation. DISCLOSED DISCREPANCY, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER: secondary accounts date the first grid feed of the 300 kWp section variously within 1986-1988 - the DELPHOS I engineering project is described as running 1985-1988, and one account has the first section beginning to supply the national grid 'at the end of August' of an unstated year. EVERY ONE OF THOSE DATES IS BEFORE 1 JANUARY 1990, so the grant does not turn on resolving the discrepancy; the citation of record is the ENEA inauguration date of 13 December 1986, and the discrepancy is disclosed so that a later reader does not think it was missed.

Agusta's A129 Mangusta, first flight 15 September 1983 and entering Italian Army service in 1990, flies composite main rotor blades on a substantially composite airframe; Aeritalia had been building the Boeing 767's composite control surfaces in series since 1982.
Comau, Fiat's manufacturing-systems arm at Turin, built the SMART robot family and the body-shop lines they ran in; Olivetti's SIGMA of 1975 was one of the first assembly robots.

LIMB A as in the technology note. LIMB B: Advanced Set. CLASS E2: Bozzola M, Cisternino M, Valtorta A, Moretta A et al., 'Effect of biosynthetic methionyl growth hormone (GH) therapy on the immune function in GH-deficient children', Hormone Research 1989;31(4):153-6 (PMID 2571554), Pediatric Clinic, 2nd Chair, University of Pavia. Biosynthetic methionyl growth hormone is somatrem, a recombinant protein made in E. coli, and the paper studies a side question ABOUT children already on the therapy, which is what makes it evidence of service rather than of a first trial. LIMB C SEARCHED, AND ONE NEAR-MISS RECORDED SO IT IS NOT RE-ARGUED: I found Italian clinical papers on human insulin from 1989 (e.g. Diabete & Metabolisme 1989, Diabetic Clinic, Casa di Cura S. Rita, Taranto, PMID 2668056) but they specify SEMISYNTHETIC human insulin, which is enzymatically converted porcine insulin and NOT recombinant, so I did not use them. This cell rests on somatrem alone.

LIMB A: cross-sectional imaging in general hospital service across the OECD before 1990 (see technology note). LIMB B: Italy is an Advanced Set nation (OECD member 1 Jan 1990; World Bank high-income 1990 grouping; authored major). CLASS E2, two dated Italian instances, one for the installed base and one for both modalities in the same hospital. (i) Pinto A, de Denaro M, Giribona P, Giuricin C, '[Evaluation of the performance of 8 computerized tomographs in clinical use in Italy]', La Radiologia Medica 1988;76(3):210-6 (PMID 3175074), Centro di Valutazione Apparecchiature Biomediche, USSL 1 Triestina - a quality-assurance evaluation of EIGHT computed tomographs ALREADY IN CLINICAL USE in Italy, published September 1988; a national performance audit of an installed fleet presupposes the fleet. (ii) Dal Pozzo G, Mascalchi M, Fonda C, Cadelo M, 'Lower cranial nerve palsy due to dissection of the internal carotid artery: CT and MR imaging', Journal of Computer Assisted Tomography 1989;13(6):989-95 (PMID 2584511), Department of Clinical Physiopathology, University of Florence - both modalities applied to the same patients in an Italian university hospital in 1989. LIMB C SEARCHED: I looked for a named fact placing Italy outside OECD imaging deployment - a moratorium, a certificate-of-need bar, an import restriction, a published shortfall - and found none. Grant rests on the MRI-and-conventional-CT half, not on helical CT.

LIMB A: as above - ISO 9735 (1987) and seven named national electronic customs and cargo systems in OECD service before the start date. LIMB B: Italy is in the Advanced Set. EVIDENCE E4, a binding instrument in force in the nation before 31 December 1989 that presupposes the technology's operation: circolare n. 100 of 31 MARCH 1988 of the Ministero delle Finanze, Dogane e Imposte Indirette gave operators, for the first time, the right to present themselves at customs with magnetic media carrying the data of the customs declaration, ordered according to a specific record layout prescribed by the customs directorate in technical-operational circulars. At the customs data-processing department the diskettes were read by computer and the data loaded automatically into the customs system, populating the fields of the terminal mask, with the customs officer's role becoming verification of the auto-loaded data before the declaration was sent to the system - a notable reduction in time and in manual copying errors. The instrument is dated, national and binding, and it presupposes two things at once: a prescribed machine syntax for the Italian customs entry, and a national customs computer system already in operation to ingest it. LIMB C SEARCHED: no fact was found placing Italy outside computerised customs entry. What the search did find is that Italy's on-line telematic customs system, AIDA (Automazione Integrata Dogane Accise), became operational only on 10 November 2003 - which bounds the claim rather than defeating it. DISCLOSED LIMIT, AND IT IS A REAL ONE THAT SHOULD BE READ BEFORE THIS CELL IS RELIED ON: Italy's 1988 route is BATCH lodgement on magnetic media, not a telecommunications interchange. It is weaker than DAKOSY, INTIS, SOFI, FCP80, ABI or Air-NACCS, every one of which is an on-line system carrying messages over a wire. The cell is granted because the node's substance, in the registry's own words, is that a box nobody can describe in a message must be described on paper by hand - and circolare 100 is precisely the moment the Italian customs entry stopped being hand-copied and acquired a prescribed machine syntax. A reader who reads the node as requiring telecommunications rather than a machine-readable syntax should reverse this cell; of the nine cells this pass adds, it is the one I would reverse first.

The Direttissima Roma-Firenze, the first purpose-built high-speed line in Europe, opened more than half its length on 24 February 1977 with a 250 km/h operating speed; the Citta della Pieve-Arezzo (1985) and Valdarno-Florence (1986) sections were in service by the start date, and ETR 450 Pendolino high-speed service was introduced on Rome-Milan in 1988-89. Webuild Group, 'Rome-Florence Direttissima High Speed Railway'; Wikipedia, 'Florence-Rome high-speed railway'.

BUCKET C, NAMED-STATISTIC BAR. CLASS E1, a published per-country area with a published trajectory: Jensen MH & Malter AJ, 'Protected Agriculture: A Global Review', World Bank Technical Paper No. 253 (April 1995), Western Europe chapter: 'Although it is not well known, Italy has the second largest area under cover in Europe. The greenhouse industry expanded from 624 ha in 1960 to over 5,000 ha in 1970, and then to 18,500 ha in 1990. Most of this tremendous growth has been under plastic. More than 50 percent of the total area is heated and most of the production is in vegetable crops.' Table 40, 'Plastic greenhouses in western Europe 1990-91 (ha.)', lists Italy at 18,500 ha against Spain 25,000, France 5,800, Greece 4,240 and England 350. WHY A FIGURE LABELLED 1990 IS ADMISSIBLE ON A 1 JANUARY 1990 BOARD, STATED SO IT IS NOT MISTAKEN FOR CARELESSNESS: section 1.3's date defeater exists to exclude a product that first shipped after the board (see comp_risc_superscalar, the F-class turbine, the infant Hib conjugate). This is not that. It is a thirty-year accumulated AREA STOCK with a published trajectory - 624 ha in 1960, over 5,000 in 1970, 18,500 in 1990 - and no reading of that series puts Italy near zero on 1 January 1990. LIMB C SEARCHED: nothing found placing Italy outside protected cultivation; the defeater search instead turned up corroboration, that Sicily alone held nearly 8,000 ha of greenhouses by 1994 (Acta Horticulturae 481, 'Greenhouse industry in Italy').
